ERP & WMS integration · one partner for robot + software

Your robot talks to your systems.

Service Robot Co. connects commercial robots to SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, MS Dynamics, and any WMS — no rip-and-replace. Robots slot into the workflow you already run, and we own both the deployment and the integration under one contract.

Most robot projects stall because the OEM delivers the machine and leaves the software hook-up to you. We deploy the robot and build the connector — one accountable owner from first install to ongoing upkeep.

Get a free site assessmentAll solutions

/ the problem

What happens when a robot has no software hook-up.

Robot moves that no one tracks

Every time a robot moves a pallet or delivers a tray, it should create a record. Without integration it does not — and inventory and billing data drift.

A science project in the corner

A robot with no software hook-up runs its route and does nothing for the rest of your operation. Integration is what turns it from a demo into a workflow.

Four vendors, four support queues

The robot OEM and the ERP vendor both say the other one owns the integration. One partner for both sides means one accountable owner when it breaks.

/ systems we connect

Works with the stack you already run.

We integrate across ERPs, WMS platforms, and custom APIs. If it has a REST endpoint or a data feed, we can connect it.

/ how it works

Three steps to a robot that actually talks to your systems.

01

Map the workflow

We walk your floor and your software stack — what triggers a robot move, what the system needs to know when it completes, where the data goes.

02

Build the connector

We write the integration layer between the robot's API and your WMS or ERP, so the robot appears in your system as a standard asset — not a foreign object someone has to manually update.

03

Deploy live

The robot goes on your floor with the integration active from day one. No parallel systems to run. No new UI for your team to learn.

Common questions

Does the robot need to replace our existing WMS?
No. We connect the robot to the systems you already run — WMS, ERP, inventory, whatever is live — so the robot slots into your workflow instead of building a new one. No rip-and-replace.
What systems can you connect?
We integrate with SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, MS Dynamics, Infor, Fishbowl, Manhattan WMS, Blue Yonder, and most systems with a REST API or SFTP data feed. We assess the stack on the initial call — if a connector exists we use it; if not, we build it.
Who owns the integration after it is built?
We do. The integration is part of the ongoing service agreement, so when your WMS updates or the robot firmware changes, we maintain the connection — not your IT team.
Can robots from different OEMs run together in the same system?
Yes. Multi-brand floors can be orchestrated to VDA 5050 / Open-RMF standards so robots from different makers coordinate instead of fighting at intersections. We assess whether your fleet needs this on the walkthrough.
We run ERPNext — can you help with that too?
Yes — ERPNext is the ERP we deploy and run for robot operators directly. If you want to run your robot operations on a real open-source ERP, see the dedicated ERP page.
